newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bangladesh will have its second television centre tomorrow (Thursday) in the port city of Chittgong.
The US Agency for International Development (USAID) will help Bangladesh to set up small power plants in rural areas.
Prince Charles, the prince of Wales, will visit Bangladesh February 26-28, British High Commission in Dhaka said.
Commerce and Industries Minister Tofael Ahmed said on Tuesday Bangladesh would soon have duty-free access to the markets of some developed countries.
A ruling party MP Khademul Islam died of heart disease in Dhaka on Wednesday.
Bangladesh will soon receive British Prime Minister John Major and Prime Minister H D Deve Gowda of India.
Snack food may constitute around 40-45 percent of food processing sector in Bangladesh which accounts for two percent of GDP.
